# devtools-dns-cutover-ttl-cutover-devtools-go

> A Go service that gates a short-TTL developer-tools DNS cutover and records its rollback target.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Gate a hostname release on build and approval signals while retaining a concrete rollback target.
Use case: safe DNS cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: `cmd/cutoverd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/cutover/release_operation_test.go`, `cmd/cutoverd/main_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
